raw_graphql_pull_request.body: Fixes #58742. MFU/MBU silently dropped attention and FFN for gpt-oss (gpt_oss_mxfp4), DeepSeek-V4 FP8 (deepseek_v4_fp8), GPTQ (auto_gptq) and AWQ (auto_awq) because their quant config names were missing from _QUANT_WEIGHT_BYTE_SIZE, and ModelMetrics only logged the failure at debug level. This PR adds those four names with their verified byte sizes and, for any still-unknown method (e.g. online, humming, modelopt_mixed), falls back to the model-dtype weight size set by BaseConfigParser with a logger.warning_once instead of dropping the component. The unknown-method test now asserts that fallback (bfloat16 -> 2 bytes). Local test scope (CPU-only VM, no accelerator): tests/v1/metrics/test_perf_metrics.py - 76 passed, 0 failed; the teardown errors in that run are only vLLM's cleanup hook calling torch.accelerator.empty_cache() with no accelerator device present, not test failures. DeepSeek-V4 MLA attention gap noted in the issue is separate and not fixed here. Written with: Muse (Meta AI assistant); I ran the checks above and reviewed the results.

detail.body: Fixes #58742. MFU/MBU silently dropped attention and FFN for gpt-oss (gpt_oss_mxfp4), DeepSeek-V4 FP8 (deepseek_v4_fp8), GPTQ (auto_gptq) and AWQ (auto_awq) because their quant config names were missing from _QUANT_WEIGHT_BYTE_SIZE, and ModelMetrics only logged the failure at debug level. This PR adds those four names with their verified byte sizes and, for any still-unknown method (e.g. online, humming, modelopt_mixed), falls back to the model-dtype weight size set by BaseConfigParser with a logger.warning_once instead of dropping the component. The unknown-method test now asserts that fallback (bfloat16 -> 2 bytes). Local test scope (CPU-only VM, no accelerator): tests/v1/metrics/test_perf_metrics.py - 76 passed, 0 failed; the teardown errors in that run are only vLLM's cleanup hook calling torch.accelerator.empty_cache() with no accelerator device present, not test failures. DeepSeek-V4 MLA attention gap noted in the issue is separate and not fixed here. Written with: Muse (Meta AI assistant); I ran the checks above and reviewed the results.

-    assert attn_result.weight_byte_size == 0.5, (

+    # gpt_oss_mxfp4 quantizes MoE experts only; its attention weights stay
+    # at the mock model dtype (bfloat16, 2 bytes).
+    expected_attn = 2 if quant_method == "gpt_oss_mxfp4" else 0.5
+    assert attn_result.weight_byte_size == expected_attn, (
+        f"Expected {expected_attn} for {quant_method}, got {attn_result.weight_byte_size}"
     )
 
     ffn_result = FfnMetrics.get_parser().parse(vllm_config)
@@ -993,6 +996,28 @@ def get_name(self):
     )
 
 
+def test_gpt_oss_mxfp4_attention_keeps_model_dtype():
+    """gpt_oss_mxfp4: attention stays BF16, FFN experts are MXFP4 (0.5)."""
+
+    class MockQuantConfig:
+        def get_name(self):
+            return "gpt_oss_mxfp4"
+
+    hf_config = Qwen3Config(
+        hidden_size=2048,
+        num_attention_heads=16,
+        intermediate_size=8192,
+        num_hidden_layers=1,
+    )
+    vllm_config = create_mock_vllm_config(hf_config, quant_config=MockQuantConfig())
+
+    attn_result = AttentionMetrics.get_parser().parse(vllm_config)
+    assert attn_result.weight_byte_size == 2
+
+    ffn_result = FfnMetrics.get_parser().parse(vllm_config)
+    assert ffn_result.weight_byte_size == 0.5
+
+
 # FP8 / INT8 quantization methods (weight_byte_size == 1)
 _FP8_INT8_METHODS = [m for m, s in _QUANT_WEIGHT_BYTE_SIZE.items() if s == 1]
 
@@ -1025,7 +1050,8 @@ def get_name(self):
 
 
 def test_quantization_config_parser_unknown_method():
-    """Test that an unrecognized quant method raises InvalidComponent."""
+    """Test that an unrecognized quant method falls back to the model

     class MockQuantConfig:
         def get_name(self):

     )
     vllm_config = create_mock_vllm_config(hf_config, quant_config=MockQuantConfig())
 
-    with pytest.raises(InvalidComponent):

@@ -68,8 +68,21 @@ class InvalidComponent(Exception):
     "moe_wna16": 0.5,
     "inc": 0.5,
     "experts_int8": 1,
+    # Added 2026: configs renamed/added after the table was last expanded.
+    "gpt_oss_mxfp4": 0.5,
+    "deepseek_v4_fp8": 1,
+    "auto_gptq": 0.5,
+    "auto_awq": 0.5,
 }
 
+# Quantization methods whose weights are NOT quantized in attention layers,
+# even though they quantize other layers. gpt_oss_mxfp4 quantizes MoE experts
+# only: Mxfp4Config skips attention layers ("MXFP4 attention layer is not
+# implemented"), so gpt-oss attention weights stay at the model dtype (BF16).
+# The table entry above is therefore for FFN/expert weights only; the
+# attention parser must not apply it.
+_ATTENTION_KEEPS_MODEL_DTYPE = frozenset({"gpt_oss_mxfp4"})
+
 
 #### Basic Data Types ####
 
@@ -465,11 +478,19 @@ def parse(self, args: ParsedArgs, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> ParsedArgs:
             return args
 
         quant_method = cfg.get_name()
+        if quant_method in _ATTENTION_KEEPS_MODEL_DTYPE:
+            # Attention weights are not quantized for this method, so keep
+            # the model-dtype size already set by BaseConfigParser.
+            return args
         if quant_method in _QUANT_WEIGHT_BYTE_SIZE:
             args.weight_byte_size = _QUANT_WEIGHT_BYTE_SIZE[quant_method]
         else:
-            raise InvalidComponent(
-                f"Unsupported quantization method for attention metrics: {quant_method}"
+            # Fall back to the model-dtype size set by BaseConfigParser
+            # instead of dropping the whole component silently.
+            logger.warning_once(
+                "Unsupported quantization method for attention metrics: %s; "
+                "falling back to model dtype weight size",
+                quant_method,
             )
 
         return args
@@ -1125,8 +1146,12 @@ def parse(self, args: ParsedArgs, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> ParsedArgs:
         if quant_method in _QUANT_WEIGHT_BYTE_SIZE:
             args.weight_byte_size = _QUANT_WEIGHT_BYTE_SIZE[quant_method]
         else:
-            raise InvalidComponent(
-                f"Unsupported quantization method for FFN metrics: {quant_method}"
+            # Fall back to the model-dtype size set by BaseConfigParser
+            # instead of dropping the whole component silently.
+            logger.warning_once(
+                "Unsupported quantization method for FFN metrics: %s; "
+                "falling back to model dtype weight size",
+                quant_method,
             )
 
         return args
